name: Product grid
summary: Grid of Product cards that grows with the screen width. It is a list, so screen readers hear the number of products.
figmaProps: Example with 6 Product cards. Gap via product-grid/gap. Cards fill the row and wrap at product-grid/card-min-width.
reactProps: Minimum card width in px. Default: --product-grid-card-min-width (200).
Name of the list, for example the category.
behaviour: As many columns as fit (auto-fill). Cards in a row have the same height.
a11y: Put a heading above the grid and give the list a name.
do: Combine with Active filters and Pagination.
